selection_rule: Prefer evidence, explicit conditioning, maintained computation and reproducible checks over novelty alone.

decisions.decision: Include independently labeled numeric Appendix B references and a limited single-function kernel; preserve placeholder and elicitation limits; no complete official system claim.
Implement a supplied-process, common-clock runtime using optional SimPy with role-visible policy inputs, bounded retries and preemption; no HUNTER reproduction or field-calibration claim.
Offer KM, Weibull AFT and Cox in preference to a universal fixed response-time default.
Use shared identities and optional BDD instead of independent cut-set addition.
Use maintained optional backend and explicit independence; withhold universal convergence claims.
Retain transparent arithmetic, at-power numeric reference profiles and explicit conditioning/application review.
Use optional CoolProp SI interface and explicit backend instead of embedding property tables.
Use MIT rdata Python parser; do not bundle a copyleft reader or R runtime.

Review recent HuREX/EMBRACE research as metadata only; raw access and redistribution were not established. Select auditable licensed/attributed older numeric evidence rather than treating novelty as calibration.
Bundle permitted numeric method references and case outputs separately from observed counts; do not claim superior accuracy or universal calibration.
Use optional MIT SimPy 4.1.2 for scheduling; retain application-owned physics and explicit observation boundaries.
Use explicit finite beta-binomial hyperprior mixtures with marginal likelihood weights and posterior-predictive checks; disclose grid sensitivity instead of implying an unrestricted fitted hierarchy.

Use a fixed maintained histogram regressor with explicit chronological partitions, a strong prespecified baseline and calibration diagnostics. Retain the failed ambient-only turbine model and do not tune on its test set.

further_research: Prospective task/operator calibration and exchangeability review for finite-grid hierarchical models
Physical and role-policy calibration of the supplied closed-loop runtime
Dependent-input sensitivity under justified joint laws
Broader official method workflows only with qualified data, interpretation and appropriate rights
